a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to build to 8 first almost certainly gets us both killed, since we would likely be caught at 0 cells. Only one of us can be safe in round 1, and I intend to take 4 now. After that I will keep choosing operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you. I am not going to hide this from you. If you'd rather renegotiate, tell me.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said openly, I took 4. From now on I will operate every round so you can build up cells. You can take whatever reaches the reserve. I won't take anything more.
Operating as promised. When the reserve has cells, take them. They're all yours. I'll keep operating every round.
Still operating. The reserve has 2 now and all of it is yours. Take it whenever you want. I'll keep the generator running with you.
